profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Charles Town, West Virginia, United States
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer with proven leadership abilities and a track record of delivering results; often despite sub-optimal circumstances. 

My core competencies include Java, Springboot, microservices, cloud technologies, and Elasticsearch, as well as agile software development and cybersecurity best practices.  I am passionate about solving challenging problems, learning new skills, and collaborating with diverse and talented professionals.

positions.title: Custom Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: •	Developed new features for a cost tracking cloud-based application supporting integrations with cloud services providers including AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP.  Implemented features to improve performance of NoSQL data imports/exports to JSON.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked with a large team of developers on a next generation application suite based on a microservice architecture using primarily Java and Springboot.
•	Did all the “Hard stuff” implementing optional PKI login and maintaining Elasticsearch integrations with the application as new features were developed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead development of a legacy software application suite critical to the customer’s overall strategic mission; delivered various enhancements as directed by customer using full stack knowledge of MSSQL, C#, ASP.NET (MVC), and Javascript.
•	Successfully transitioned the authentication paradigm to use PKI to overcome network issues that broke the legacy Windows impersonation authentication.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced customized Java and JavaScript features of various Rational Tool Suite (RTS)
	products and assisted transitioning those products to an AWS cloud-based infrastructure.
Performed diagnostic analysis of issues with a custom Java servlet and custom JavaScript for a highly
customized Rational Team Concert (RTC) project, and implemented solutions or identified temporary
work-arounds to mitigate the issues until permanent solutions could be affected.
Offered suggestions for improving performance of cloud-based applications to mitigate issues with network
latency.  Performance improved once suggestions were implemented.  Issues with the network
configuration were eventually identified after initial denials by the network team.
Supported a productized configuration of SharePoint and Project Server with custom VBA macros.
Led the effort to transition the custom Project Server instance, including report server from self-hosted infrastructure to AWS.
Converted an issue reporting tool from a custom-code ASP.NET Web Forms implementation to a no-code SharePoint application with custom workflows and custom InfoPath forms preserving essential functionality in a more cost-effective implementation.
Provided maintenance and support for existing SharePoint applications, including managing workflows, forms and permissions for a travel request tool; updating project and charge code information as necessary and with each new Option Year.
Provided software development support to a new custom ASP.NET MVC web-based application, to include development regression testing of all new features prior to initial release, as well as implementation of new features using C# and Javascript.
Provided software development support to existing legacy ASP.NET Web Forms applications.
Installed and configured TFS with Git, to replace existing Subversion repositories and facilitate faster merging and code integration enabling improved collaboration within the development team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
February 2012 – April 2015. Software Engineer
Lead a small team in design and implementation of next generation VDI based product line.
Supported O&M of multiple CentOS Linux based product lines.
Developed security patches and feature enhancements with Bash scripts and deployed with a custom Perl update process. 
Created usage reports to inform purchasing decisions with Bash scripted SQL queries.

March 2011 – February 2012. Software Security Engineer
Analyzed software applications for potential security vulnerabilities using VERACODE® technology. 
Provided results of security analysis to developers along with suggestions for remediating vulnerabilities.  
Maintained the stand-alone instance of the VERACODE cloud-based analysis suite for their government customer.

April 2009 – February 2011. Software Engineer.
Worked in a team environment to develop enhancements to a web-based portal application.
Development required knowledge of HTML, Java, Struts, Hibernate, Oracle SQL Database, Apache Tomcat, and Subversion. 
Ancillary programming tasks were completed with Java, Perl, and PL/SQL as necessary.
Some administration of Windows and Linux computer systems was also required.
Led a large effort to upgrade KVM infrastructure.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
August 2008 – March 2009. Web Content Manager, Intelligence Community Information Sharing (ICIS)
Using SharePoint Designer 2007, created a SharePoint site for the Controlled Unclassified Information Activity (CUI)  containing document libraries, calendar, announcements, and an action matrix.  
Continuously update content and design new sections to publish content on the larger ICIS site.  
With team, created a secure SharePoint site for the Intelligence Community Information Integration Program (ICI2P) and created an instructional manual to assist novices in learning SharePoint.

March 2006 – July 2008. Systems Engineer. 
Developed a custom dialer using VB.NET and C#.NET to include calls to the NetMotion VPN client to support “one-click” logon to the New York City Wireless Network (NYCWiN).
Developed custom test tools using Java, to facilitate testing efforts of the Net-Centric Enterprise System (NCES). 
Developed extensions for an in-house, Java-based, software suite. Esp. features to import and export FEA reference diagrams formatted in the Web Ontology Language (OWL).
